title: Research zero-waste campus measurement context
acceptance_criteria: Official Türkiye Zero Waste sources are translated into prevention, monitoring and record-keeping implications without claiming software compliance
Current UNEP food-waste/climate context is clearly separated from local Boğaziçi impact
A pilot KPI hierarchy prioritizes physical decision and measured waste outcomes before economic/climate conversions
Waste prevention is explicitly distinguished from downstream diversion/recovery
Anti-greenwashing rules prevent generic global GHG/water statistics from becoming local savings claims
A machine-readable companion exposes framework facts, KPI tiers, measurement contract and PMR questions
notes: Secondary public-source research only; not legal advice or compliance certification.
UNEP global statistics are context only and are not local conversion factors.
Does not touch KREATE/EVIDENCE.md or KREATE/ASSUMPTIONS.md.
